content.bridge_context: Division is the opposite of multiplication—it is the process of sharing or grouping equally.

units.title: Equal Sharing
units.explanation: If you have 10 sweets and 2 friends, each gets 5. This is 10 ÷ 2 = 5.
units.dual_language_instruction: Share the objects. / वस्तुओं को साझा करें।

units.title: Terms in Division
units.explanation: Dividend (total), Divisor (groups), Quotient (answer), and Remainder (left over).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the parts. / भागों की पहचान करें।
